newsitem.title: GERMANY: United raises ex-Germany cargo rates 10pct.
newsitem.headline: United raises ex-Germany cargo rates 10pct.

text.p: United Airlines said it has raised ex-Germany cargo rates by 10 percent as exports to North America pick up.
Robert Blythe, United's Germany cargo sales manager, said: "We put through a 10 percent rise across the east coast, to Chicago, Washington and the Carolinas, from March 1."
United was currently recording cargo load factors in the 90s, he told Reuters.
"We are full two weeks in advance and I just hope it keeps going," he added.
The rise in the dollar against the deutschmark had boosted German exports to North America by making goods effectively cheaper, Blythe said.
